architecture: Moshi (Kyutai) full-duplex speech-text model: a main transformer plus a depformer, with gating blocks at both levels
execution_class: streaming, real-time audio+text; latency-bound rather than throughput-bound, which makes decode TPS the wrong metric for it
why_it_was_open: ships a bare model.safetensors with no config.json; the reader had no architecture to classify from
structure: 7.784B matrix params, 673 tensors, 97.6% bf16 with a 0.36 GiB fp32 audio tokenizer alongside; depformer gating repeats 48x, transformer gating 32x
gravity_note: complete EBPW 16.198 -- the 2.4% fp32 tokenizer is the entire excess over a clean 16, and it is a SEPARATE artifact that must travel with the body. A quantization campaign that counted only model.safetensors would understate the system.
cross_layer_note: 32-48x repeated gating roles make it a valid subject for the residual reader/writer probe at no extra cost
disposition: SPECIALIST / RESEARCH SPECIMEN -- a genuinely different execution class (full-duplex streaming) worth keeping for physics work; not a Resident or Pulsar candidate because its output is audio, not verified engineering work
reopen: if the campaign needs a latency-bound rather than throughput-bound physical target
accounting_verified: tensor bytes equal on-disk bytes to two decimals after two producer defects were fixed: a DeepSpeed container that yielded zero tensors silently, and logical bytes that double-counted a storage-aliased EMA copy by 48%.
